# Synthetic Anthropic prompt-conversion cases

Every prompt in `cases.json` is synthetic: it was written for this suite as caller
input in the LanguageModelV4 prompt shape. No case contains a recorded or upstream
provider fixture, and the single response that completes each call is a fixed stub
that makes no claim about what the live Anthropic API sends.

`expected-results.jsonl` is generated by running the registered upstream
`@ai-sdk/anthropic` `doGenerate` over each prompt, so the upstream package is the
oracle. Each line holds the captured request snapshot and the call warnings.
Regenerate with `mise run generate-conformance`.

The Go comparison checks the request snapshot in full and compares warnings by
type and message. For the cases listed in `anthropicMCPResultFallthroughWarnings`,
it first verifies the upstream warning registered as
`anthropic-mcp-result-fallthrough-warning`, then removes it before comparing.
